question.title: Cumulative Product Sales
question.desc: Find the cumulative total of sales for each product over the last 3 days, starting from the earliest sale date.
question.solution:
WITH ranked_sales AS (
         SELECT p.name AS product_name, s.sale_date, s.amount,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY s.sale_date) AS row_num
         FROM sales s
         JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id
      )
      SELECT product_name, sale_date, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_name ORDER BY row_num) AS cumulative_total
      FROM (
         SELECT product_name, sale_date, amount,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_name ORDER BY sale_date) AS row_num
         FROM ranked_sales
      ) sub
      ORDER BY product_name, sale_date;
question.tips: Use window functions to calculate cumulative totals and row numbering to ensure correct ordering.
hints: You'll need to join the sales and products tables to get the product names.
Use a window function to calculate the cumulative total for each product over time.
To ensure the correct ordering, use ROW_NUMBER() to assign a row number to each sale date for each product.
